rows.text: "What's the!?" Herta stops you and pauses the Simulated Universe. Her nose scrunches in annoyance as she complains, "Stephen Lloyd promised me that the audience with the Aeons would be done in a sacred and solemn way. Why is the Communing Device done like this?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It's quite interesting...
It's quite unique...

"As if! Do I really have to check every single detail myself? What is Ruan Mei doing?" Looking displeased, Herta continues, "What do they think they are doing with the Simulated Universe? Whatever, I don't care anymore. Do whatever."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Based on the original design, the Audience Dice is a vessel similar to a shrine that carries the past and experiences of various Pathstriders, and the energy that flows due to it." Herta's nose twitches as she adds, "Originally, anyway."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "I'll let it be since it has happened. I wish you have a great time with the Communing Device. Or not, it doesn't matter. I have a score to settle with that kid Stephen."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "I'm really puzzled as to why I'm in charge of the tutorial on the Simulated Universe. When did it become my responsibility?" Sneering, Herta seems to have come up with a brilliant idea. "I must bring Ruan Mei and Screwllum here and let them do some real work. [Trailblazer], you're about to meet some big shots soon."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "I can join, but I don't think Stephen's opinion is helpful to the study of Aeons." An indifferent voice emerges. She makes her statement clear and concise.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei

rows.text: Who's this?
A wild Ruan Mei has appeared!
Who designed your avatar?

"Why did you come in so soon? I haven't introduced you yet." Herta shrugs, "Genius Society #81, Ruan Mei, a genius in the field of biology. Should I quote the evaluation from the IPC? 'Ruan Mei possesses extraordinary perception and cognitive integration abilities, easily capturing microscopic details of reality and synthesizing them into a torrent of information within her mind, which she uses for deductive thinking. She's very low-key...' Low-key? That's hilarious!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Have you met her before?" Herta frowns but does not probe. "Genius Society #81, Ruan Mei, a genius in the field of biology. Should I quote the evaluation from the IPC? 'Ruan Mei possesses extraordinary perception and cognitive integration abilities, easily capturing microscopic details of reality and synthesizing them into a torrent of information within her mind, which she uses for deductive thinking. She's very low-key...' Low-key? That's hilarious!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "It was me, of course. Aren't they cute? As for you... Why did you come in so soon? I haven't introduced you yet." Herta shrugs and continues, "Genius Society #81, Ruan Mei, a genius in the field of biology. Should I quote the evaluation from the IPC? 'Ruan Mei possesses extraordinary perception and cognitive integration abilities, easily capturing microscopic details of reality and synthesizing them into a torrent of information within her mind, which she uses for deductive thinking. She's very low-key...' Low-key? That's hilarious!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "But then again, it's typical of Stephen to do things like that. We want to study the Aeons, but I'm not sure about him." Herta looks back at you and continues, "Well, I've explained everything I can. You have to count on yourself after this. In this expansion module, the flow of time is locked, so you'll see the Simulated Universe divided into several planes."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How do you feel?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: This is pretty interesting.
I don't feel anything different.
After Screwllum has finished gathering the planar data, I'll add in the previous Aeons' information.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Then, you can start exploring the Swarm Disaster.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hm?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: About Swarm Disaster...
About Gold and Gears...
About the Unknowable Domain...
That's all. See you soon.
What kind of questions do you have?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How will I learn of Propagation's secrets?
I still have some questions...

Continue along the Trail of Pathstrider, and walk along the traces already paved by those who came before you, and try your hardest to get closer to the Aeons! Don't worry! Just carry out the Paths in the way you want to.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Don't forget to test my Simulated Universe!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What kind of questions do you have?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How will I learn of Erudition's secrets?

Hmm, good question. Pay close attention to your Intra-Cognition at all times to prevent yourself from becoming a robot or totally losing your rationality. Don't think too much. You'll eventually end up following THEIR calculations anyways.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What kind of questions do you have?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: How will we solve the Unknowable Domain?
Will Polka Kakamond come back?
I still have some questions...
So long as I walk along the Path of Erudition, I think I'll end up meeting her again one day. I just don't know what she'll do to greet me next time...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Something's off... Why am I looking forward to this?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Collect data about the Scholars' Strife and replicate the complete Scepter system. Then, Rubert II's legacy will naturally show us the way.
rows.speaker: Herta
